description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Delinquency and Chargeback functionalities within the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup, helper methods, and test cases that simulate loan creation, repayment, chargebacks, and delinquency classification, leveraging REST API calls and business date manipulations.
